newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Pharmacia tops ADR action.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Pharmacia tops ADR action.

text.p: Shares in Swedish-American drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc fell in New York on Monday on news the company's chief executive had resigned.
The company's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) fell 2-1/2 to 38-3/8 in heavy trade after John Zabriskie said he would resign and return to the United States to pursue personal interests.
He will be temporarily replaced by chairman Jan Ekberg. The company's shares were among the most heavily traded on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Netherlands' Madge Networks Inc was up one to 13-5/8, also on heavy volume, after the company said it had developed a new switching and routing packet.
French oil company Elf Aquitaine rose 7/8 to 47-5/8 after Goldman Sachs raised its rating for the company to market outperformer from performer. Spanish oil company Repsol SA was up 1/8 to 43-5/8.
Britain's Thorn Plc fell 2-7/8 to 14-1/4 after the electrical retailer and rental company warned annual profits would be largely unchanged from last year.
Decliners led advancers by 258 to 216 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 26 million shares in late morning.
